function.name: move_to_location
function.description: Move the player from the current location to an existing location. Rejects blocked routes; records connected exits and actual movement.

function.name: move_to_new_location
function.description: Establish a contextually plausible destination, resolving existing location identity before creating. Move the player there and return its canonical ID.

function.name: create_item
function.description: Establish a plausible item in an existing location (not inventory). Resolve against tracked available items first; an existing match keeps its holder/location. Return canonical ID.

function.name: pick_up_item
function.description: Pick up an EXISTING accessible item using its item_id from the scene or a successful create_item result. If the item does not exist, call create_item FIRST and wait for its ID. Never pass a name or description to this tool. May take an item held by a present active NPC.

function.name: drop_item
function.description: Place a carried item in the player's current location.

function.name: destroy_item
function.description: Destroy or completely consume an available item accessible in the current scene or player inventory. Removes its record.

function.name: create_npc
function.description: Establish a plausible NPC in an existing location. Resolve against tracked NPCs first; an existing match is not moved or revived. Return canonical ID.

function.name: destroy_npc
function.description: Mark a present active NPC dead, keeping its canonical record. Items it held are left in its location.

function.name: move_npc
function.description: Move a present active NPC to an existing location without moving the player. Rejects blocked routes; held items remain with the NPC.
